about_the_game:
The Stars do not Lie, and they have chosen You.

Will you answer Their call?

Become a Star-Coat, a protector of the universe who seek to protect the Stars from those who wish Their inhabitants harm. Wield your COAT, a customizable walker that turns you into a one person army. With your COAT and weapons, traverse through shifting dungeons and defeat the bosses that command the enemies of the Stars. Each run is different from the last so be prepared.

Fight

The Stars are full of those who want to claim Them for themselves. Show them They do not belong to those seeking to conquer.

Forge

Your enemies carry materials, materials that our smiths can craft stronger gear from. Choose wisely and upgrade your arsenal, so the enemies of the Stars will not prevail against you.

Fashion

Of course, the Stars do not oppose wanting to look your very best as you take down its enemies. Choose from an assortment of armor and dyes to remind your foes the true beauty of the Stars.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 or AMD Radeon RX Vega 56
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Star-Coat is a third person shooter where you dive into procedurally generated maps to fight corrupted enemies and the bosses that command them. Outfit your pilot and your COAT, a fearsome walker, with a variety of weapons and armor to help you defeat evil in the universe.
